items.rationale: The confirmed surge damage is covered under 2.3.3 and 4.2.4, with no 50% reduction because of the endorsement. Reversing that reduction in Case 1 gives a combined benchmark of EUR 1,562–1,800; about EUR 630 is attributable to a like-for-like speaker system under 7.1.9, and the combined estimate is below the EUR 5,000 cap.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes delivery of replacement equipment even when the supplier invoices it alongside covered equipment.
Clause 7.1.8(c) excludes installation and setup of replacement equipment, even if the original equipment was installed.

The confirmed surge damage is covered under 2.3.3 and 4.2.4, and the endorsement waives the 50% reduction. A like-for-like TV under 7.1.9 accounts for about EUR 1,050 of the EUR 1,680 combined replacement estimate calibrated to Case 1; the EUR 5,000 aggregate cap does not reduce it.
Clauses 3.1.4 and 3.1.5 exclude the combined arrangement charge. No physical-damage amount is separately itemised and priced, so there is nothing to apportion to covered damage.

items.description: Service order for property and liability arrangement
items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude charges for placing or administering an order under the arrangement, even when the order follows an insured event.
Clause 7.1.8(d) allows an attendance charge only when the same invoice contains indemnifiable work. The covered replacements appear on a separate invoice, so the vehicle charge is excluded.
